For security-sensitive findings, please follow SECURITY.md instead of posting details publicly.

## Description

## Reproduction

Provide the affected commit, Go version, operating system, commands and a minimal example using synthetic data.

## Evidence

Include relevant error output or failing tests. Remove private keys, credentials and personal information.
